projects.title: PaRappa the Rapper 2 Decompilation
projects.status: Work in progress; currently targets the July 12 NTSC-J prototype. The README lists separate Emotion Engine and IOP workstreams and does not claim a completed matching executable.
projects.summary: A matching decompilation of the PS2 game, currently targeting the July 12 NTSC-J prototype. The public repository tracks Emotion Engine and IOP modules; game data must be supplied from the user's own copy.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user-supplied game data required

projects.title: Haunting Ground Decompilation and Native PC Port (OpenHuey)
projects.status: The README reports a working title, rooms, cutscenes, gameplay, saving/loading, and endings. About 20 story-script commands and the Hewie-play mode remain unfinished.
projects.summary: The project functionally decompiles Haunting Ground's PS2 code to C and runs it natively on PC with a PC renderer. An actor-oriented Forth rewrite is also under development. The build requires the US executable SLUS_210.75 and user-supplied game data; neither is included.
projects.strategy: Functional decompilation with a native PC runtime
projects.source_available: Public source repository; original executable and game data required

projects.title: Spider-Man 2 PS2 Recompilation
projects.status: Not playable yet. The README reports that the current Windows build boots through the initial blockers and renders the memory-card warning and game logos; legal-splash text and rendering work remain.
projects.summary: Experimental static recompilation of the USA PS2 release SLUS-20776. The public source includes recompiler/runtime code, tests, and Ghidra scripts. The game executable, disc image, assets, and generated game code are excluded and must be supplied or generated locally from the user's own disc.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user-supplied legal game files required

projects.title: Burnout 3: Takedown PS2 Recompilation for PC
projects.status: Alpha PC port. The README describes native operation across menus, races, crash mode, career, and saves; it requires the user's own NTSC-U disc image.
projects.summary: Translates the PS2 game's program to C++ and compiles it for Windows, with a Vulkan renderer, widescreen, and PC settings. The repository and releases exclude game content; users provide their own SLUS-21050 disc image.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation of PS2 game code to native C++
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user-supplied game disc required; no game content included

projects.title: Virtua Tennis Dreamcast Decompilation
projects.status: Work in progress. The README reports equivalent C for 417 of 3,280 functions (12.7%), no matching C functions yet, and 1,033 named functions for the USA MK-51054 v1.001 build.
projects.summary: Dreamcast decompilation and rebuild tools for the USA release MK-51054 v1.001. Functionally equivalent C is tested against the original; byte-matching is a further goal. Setup requires the user's own disc and Katana SDK, and refuses other releases.
projects.strategy: Functional-equivalence decompilation with byte-matching as a further goal
projects.source_available: Public source repository; user-supplied Dreamcast disc and Katana SDK required

sources.label: Project README: supported release, method, requirements, and progress report

projects.title: Crazy Taxi Dreamcast Decompilation
projects.status: Work in progress. The README reports equivalent C for 443 of 2,827 functions (15.7%) and eight matching functions for the European MK-51035 v1.000 build.
projects.summary: A Dreamcast decompilation with function-by-function behavioral tests and a byte-matching rebuild goal. The current supported release is the European English/Japanese MK-51035 v1.000 build; setup refuses other revisions. Game-derived files are generated locally from the user's own disc.
projects.source_available: Public source repository; game-derived files generated from the user's own Dreamcast disc

projects.title: Castlevania Chronicles PS1 Recompilation
projects.platform: PlayStation → Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64
projects.status: v0.3.10 released; full-game compatibility remains under test. The README says all eight stage overlays are registered but explicitly does not treat that as a full playthrough validation.
projects.summary: A desktop recompilation of the USA PlayStation release SLUS-01384, with v0.3.10 packages for Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, and Linux x64. The project uses RecompOne; users provide their own CUE/BIN or CHD disc image.
projects.source_available: Public source repository and release packages; user-supplied disc required

projects.title: Midnight Ghost Stone: Metal Gear Solid PS1 Recompilation
projects.platform: PlayStation USA v1.0 (SLUS-00594 / SLUS-00776) → Windows x64, Linux x86-64
projects.status: Experimental alpha.1 is marked untested; the maintainer says the builds are for early testing and does not certify campaign completion or platform compatibility.
projects.summary: A PC recompilation project that uses static MIPS-to-native recompilation for most game logic, with selected decompiled C routines. It presents original assets through Vulkan. The project-specific work is labeled AI-generated under human direction; discs, extracted assets, and generated translations are excluded. Only the USA v1.0 discs are currently targeted.
projects.strategy: Static MIPS-to-native recompilation with selected decompiled C routines
projects.source_available: Public source and untested prerelease packages; user-supplied USA v1.0 discs and extracted assets required
projects.subtype: PS1 static recompilation with Vulkan presentation

projects.title: Rogue Trip: Vacation 2012 Recompilation
projects.status: v0.1.0 Linux AppImage; the README reports testing on Garuda x86-64 with menus and the first level working. The rest of the game has not been fully tested.
projects.summary: A PS1 static recompilation built with PSXRecomp. The README targets the USA SLUS-00643 disc, requires the user's own 17-track image, and reports only Linux testing; OpenBIOS is included.
projects.source_available: Public source repository and Linux release; user-supplied game disc required; OpenBIOS included
